emojibase-data (English dataset)
================================

Upstream: https://github.com/milesj/emojibase
NPM:      https://www.npmjs.com/package/emojibase-data
License:  MIT (see LICENSE in this directory)
Pinned version: 17.0.0

Files vendored here:
  compact.json    - from emojibase-data/en/compact.json
  messages.json   - from emojibase-data/en/messages.json
  LICENSE         - upstream repo's LICENSE file

How to refresh this data
------------------------

1. Check the current version:
     curl -s https://registry.npmjs.org/emojibase-data/latest \
       | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['version'])"

2. Download the new files (replace <V> with the version):
     curl -fsSL "https://unpkg.com/emojibase-data@<V>/en/compact.json" \
       -o vendor/emojibase/compact.json
     curl -fsSL "https://unpkg.com/emojibase-data@<V>/en/messages.json" \
       -o vendor/emojibase/messages.json
     curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/milesj/emojibase/v<V>/LICENSE" \
       -o vendor/emojibase/LICENSE

3. Update the "Pinned version" line in this file to <V>.

4. Bump EMOJI_DATA_VERSION in deck.js (e.g. 'v1' -> 'v2') so users'
   cached index is rebuilt on next deck open.
